records.title: Early detection of sugarcane smut and mosaic diseases via hyperspectral imaging and spectral-spatial attention deep neural networks
records.abstractSummary: The study combines hyperspectral imaging and deep learning for sugarcane smut and mosaic disease detection, tracks disease development over five months, releases a large healthy/inoculated dataset, and reports over 90% detection accuracy before visible symptoms.

records.title: Diffusion-Model-Based Hyperspectral Unmixing Using Spectral Prior Distribution
records.abstractSummary: DiffUn learns a continuous spectral prior from a library with an unconditional diffusion model, combines it with the linear-mixture likelihood, and samples endmembers and abundances from a posterior for semi-blind unmixing.

records.title: Few-Shot Hyperspectral Image Classification Using Relational Generative Adversarial Network
records.abstractSummary: FSHyperRGAN generates label-conditioned virtual samples, reconstructs category-preserving embeddings, computes relations among original/generated/reconstructed samples, and provides 1D spectral and 3D spatial–spectral variants.

records.title: Hy-Tracker: A Novel Framework for Enhancing Efficiency and Accuracy of Object Tracking in Hyperspectral Videos
records.abstractLevel: official arXiv abstract for related preprint
records.abstractSummary: Hy-Tracker adapts YOLOv7 to multi-band hyperspectral video, refines detections with a tracking module, and uses a Kalman filter for scale variation and occlusion; formal 2024 and 2023 preprint boundaries remain separate.
